messages.content: What's the current traffic condition in New York?

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live traffic feeds. I can’t provide the current traffic conditions in New York right now. If you’re looking for up‑to‑date traffic information, you might want to check a real‑time traffic app or website (e.g., Google Maps, Waze, or the NYC DOT traffic page). Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!

There's no function for traffic. We might need to answer with a general statement or ask for clarification. We could say we don't have real-time data. We can provide approximate or mention that we can't fetch real-time traffic. We can ask if they want a specific area. Probably best to respond that we don't have real-time traffic data.
